media.title: Abenteuer am Lido (1933) — Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 677
media.description: Cover of Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 677, devoted to Abenteuer am Lido (1933), Richard Oswald’s Austrian film with music by Walter Jurmann and Bronisław Kaper. This is a film-program/periodical cover, not a standard theatrical film poster.
